items.Sentence: Raw wastewater will be conveyed to the Facility headworks, which will include two coarse screen and grit removal trains, a SAFE system box, and two parallel fine screens.
Screenings and grit from the headworks facilities will be hauled offsite for disposal.
Screened effluent and return activated sludge will flow into two biological nutrient removal (BNR) basins and then pumped to the MBR.
The BNR-MBR basins will be configured as two parallel activated sludge treatment trains, each consisting of pre-anoxic, aerobic, and post-anoxic basins in-series.

Tertiary treated effluent from the outfall balancing tank will be pumped through an outfall disinfection chlorine contact pipeline and will then be dechlorinated by sodium bisulfite injection prior to discharge through the ocean outfall.
A concrete tank, called the SAFE settling basin, will capture and equalize the wet weather flows prior to entering the SAFE filter system.
The SAFE settling tank will have separate piping connected to the sludge dewatering pumps to provide the capability to operate one dewatering pump to drain the tank and the other to process sludge.

Primary treated effluent from the SAFE filter system will then be routed to the outfall balancing tank where it will be blended with tertiary-treated MBR effluent and pumped by the outfall pump station to the outfall disinfection pipeline contactor and then the ocean outfall.
IPR system treatment consists of cartridge filters, an RO system, ultraviolet disinfection with advanced oxidation (UV/AOP) chlorination, and a calcite contactor.
